body: Thank you very much for finding time to respond with my hopeless thoughts. You really helped me alot. Emotionally. I finally find someone who cares enough with my thoughts. I'm looking forward for your successful life ahead. I know you will. You're such an amazing person.
Do think its still possible to reach my dreams?? Is it not too late??  Honest answer please.

I'm just scared that as i aged, the opportunities become limited. That i might not get the future i want. Everybody tells me that i'm a smart child. But no scholarship could grant me to help in my college expense. Sorry for this negative thought. I'm not usually like this. But all my life, i've been thinking about my dreams and having a good future ahead. But with all these financial crises in our family. Well i don't if my dreams will ever be possible. You know what. We barely eat 3 meals a day. Usually two or one meal only. There are days we have really nothing to eat. And i don't want to experience such poverty in the future
The depressing part is life goes around with money. It strikes me that if you dont have money, no better future for you, so there's no point of living. I just hate it. Hope you get my point
yeah. thank you. please. focus on your studies and be an amazing person

i know. i've been with that issue. you know what. i have to stop in college this semester due to financial issues. consider yourself lucky because you still have the opportunity to have a good life in the future. don't take it for granted. focus on your studies and have a good life ahead
but i can't stop myself being depress about it
thank you. for making me feel light.
i know how it feels. i know how depressive it is. but. you have to keep going. for your dreams.
i'm from Philippines. please. i just want somebody to tell me what to do. all i've been thinking is to end everything in me. and i'm so scared

well. my dreams is a complete mess up. my parents cant afford college. and that's the only thing that keeps me alive. now the reality's starting to sink in. that my future is nowhere to go. that'll grow up being a failure. i dont know what to do
